description:
[Deterministic Renewable Energy Communities incentive calculator. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates the 20-year GSE incentive tariff premium for CERs under D.M. MASE 414/2023 and ARERA TIAD 727/2022/R/eel, applying capacity tiers (<=200kW, 200-600kW, >600kW), geographic insolation corrections (Nord/Centro/Sud), and PNRR 40% capital grant adjustments.
Usage: Use this tool to model financial returns for renewable energy communities, self-consumption groups, and solar cooperatives.
Returns: JSON object with { plantPowerTier: string, tariffBreakdownEurPerMwh: object, economicRevenue: object, pnrrGrantStatus: object }.

annualProductionMWh.description: Total annual electricity generated by the plant in MWh

annualSharedEnergyMWh.description: Annual energy shared under the primary electrical substation in MWh

geographicZone.description: Italian geographic macro-zone for insolation correction

plantNominalPowerKw.description: Renewable plant peak power in kW (up to 1,000 kW)

pnrrCapitalGrant40PercentApplied.description: True if the project benefits from PNRR 40% non-repayable capital grant (<5k inhabitants)

name: cer_incentivi_gse_calculator
